## Checklist

- [ ] Commit and PR title follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] New/changed behavior has colocated `FileName.test.ts` coverage
- [ ] AI-generated tests were reviewed for correct assertions and edge cases
- [ ] Required tests pass with no undocumented skips
- [ ] Global and changed-file coverage meet 80% in all metrics
- [ ] Type, lint, format, build, and relevant E2E checks pass
- [ ] Errors, cancellation, cleanup, concurrency, retry, and redaction were considered
- [ ] Browser and SSR behavior are covered where applicable
- [ ] Dependency/package/bundle impact was reviewed
- [ ] Breaking framework changes include migration and rollback evidence
